analysis.counterPlan: Since the player anchors on the right side (columns 6-7, roughly x=650-800) and barely repositions, stop targeting their live cell with slam and instead pre-place slam or spawn on that right-side corridor before they arrive, punishing the habit rather than the position. Use charge primitives, which went completely unused this round, to threaten the two hot cells (750,350) and (650,650) simultaneously so a single lane can't stay safe. Deny the burst-punish window by feinting bursts or delaying the actual burst tick, since the player is clearly holding shots for that exact opening. Force lateral movement with a spawn wall on the east edge to push the player toward the unused left half where they have zero positional data.

Shots landed constantly during boss movement and bursts but were most efficient during burst windows, 11.6 shots per use versus only 0.1 during plain move, showing the player waited for burst telegraphs to unload. Only 6 dashes occurred all game, 4 of them east (67%) and 2 southeast (33%), suggesting minimal repositioning once a safe lane was found. The boss's own slam only connected on telegraph miss data once (t41 miss at 173.8), meaning the slam pattern was read and avoided rather than punished directly.
